# PDF export dependencies

Browser bundles hosted with the editor; loaded only when exporting PDF.

- jsPDF 4.2.1: https://github.com/parallax/jsPDF — `jspdf-LICENSE`
- svg2pdf.js 2.8.1: https://github.com/yWorks/svg2pdf.js — `svg2pdf-LICENSE`

Bundles obtained from the versioned npm distributions through jsDelivr.
